key_decisions: SHIP THE DISTILLED CHECKPOINT, ONE TIER. klein-4b-transformer now points at flux-2-klein-4b-int8-convrot.safetensors (4074445184 B, sha ac629fa69e0700ae689bce6b694ac0fc90ba5c24de15bd6c47195ad0c16fe90e). klein-lora-turbo DELETED as a dep (user call): its node is bypassed AND severed in the template, so 0.79GB nobody loads. A tombstone comment in loraDeps.js explains why the node survives - do NOT re-add the dep on the strength of that node.

ModelDef.opInject (NEW) - per-model op -> constant params map, applied in commandExecutor._buildParams. It REPLACES the op's own injectParams rather than merging: a model declaring it is saying 'my graph picks its branch differently', so the op's booleans name nodes it does not have. Klein maps its 7 ops to Input_wf_type 1..7.

ModelDef.styleOps + modelShowsStyleRack() (NEW) - the style rack is now gated per MODEL and per OP, not by the op's components list alone. Klein's one master graph carries the rack on detail and upscale; Krea2's separate detailer/upscaler files do not. Defaults to DEFAULT_STYLE_OPS = exactly the pre-Klein set, so every existing model is byte-identically unaffected.

Klein is ORIENTATION mode (type 'klein' -> FLUX_RATIOS), NO quality-tier radio. The graph runs 896x1088, i.e. FLUX ratio values. With one output class a tier radio would offer a single choice; bigger output is the upscale op's job. negativePrompt FALSE (bit-identical at cfg 1.0) and turboToggle FALSE.

kleinEdit is a NEW op with THREE reference slots (user call). Chaining ReferenceLatent is verified; 1/2/3 refs = 20/30/44 s, so three is a deliberate cap on a cost the user cannot see. Registered in operationRegistry.js + operation_registry.json at appVersionIntroduced 1.2.0.
REMOVAL uses the EXISTING `inpaint` op (landed by MPI-356 in a32b2503, explicitly anticipating Klein): requiresMask true, promptRequired false, empty prompt erases. No new op was needed.

PROGRESS_STAGES CANNOT EXPRESS KLEIN. stagesFor() keys on the WORKFLOW FILENAME with a mode of single/preview/stage2. Klein runs ALL SEVEN ops from klein_t2i.json and their bar counts genuinely differ, so one key cannot hold seven answers.
